---
title: "Repositories"
---

Live list of public repositories, pulled directly from GitHub — this page
updates itself automatically as you create or update repos, no manual edits
needed.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
repos = {
  const res = await fetch("https://api.github.com/users/chrystali2002/repos?sort=updated&per_page=100");
  const data = await res.json();
  return data.filter(r => !r.fork).sort((a, b) => b.stargazers_count - a.stargazers_count);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`${repos.map(r => `
  <div class="card-block">
    <h3><a href="${r.html_url}" target="_blank">${r.name}</a></h3>
    <p>${r.description ?? "No description provided."}</p>
    <span class="pill">${r.language ?? "—"}</span>
    <span class="pill">★ ${r.stargazers_count}</span>
    <span class="pill">Updated ${new Date(r.updated_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
  </div>
`).join("")}`
```

*If this list doesn't load (e.g. viewing offline), see the [static project highlights](projects.qmd) instead.*
